title: editor.render.requested payload (command)
description: Command issued by the Studio-hosted media editor (via the BFF) to flatten an edit timeline into a new rendition. Consumed by MTS, which renders it and emits transcode.completed. Design: docs/architecture/services/media-editor.md.

sourceAssetId.description: Asset whose renditions the timeline references.

outputAssetId.description: The id of the asset the render BECOMES, minted by MAM when the render is requested (media-editor.md §5.1). MTS places the rendered file as this asset's `original` and announces transcode.completed/progress/failed under it; MAM creates the asset on completion.

targetAssetId.description: Existing asset the rendered asset becomes the next version of (the version chain, mam.md §13t); absent = the rendered asset stands alone.

mediaKind.description: The editor operates on video, audio, or image (basic-NLE, D3).

timeline.description: The edit decision list: an ordered set of clips (source in/out → timeline position) plus optional transitions and filters. Interpreted by the render worker; the authoritative shape is the EditProject timeline (media-editor.md §3).

renditionRef.description: The file of the source asset this clip draws from, by FileRef kind — `original`, `broadcast` or `proxy` — optionally `kind/variant` (media-editor.md §5.1). In v1 every clip of a render names the same file.

transitionIn.description: The transition in from the clip before (EP-26.5); absent is a cut. Never on the first clip.

transitionSec.description: How long the transition overlaps the clip before — shorter than both clips; 0.5 when absent.

filters.description: Filters on this clip, applied in order (EP-26.5).

outputProfile.description: MTS profile id (Tier-1 registry) to encode the flattened result with.

requestedBy.description: User id who triggered the render.
